title: Issues ranked by the evidence behind them
description: How strong the public evidence is for each issue: not a measure of what voters say they care about.
notes: Ranks evidence strength: source tier, whether the indicator is quantified, and whether it is county-wide or localised.

values.label: Water
values.note: 200,000 m³ a day needed against about 40,000 supplied; 60% lost before it reaches a tap

values.label: County finance and pending bills
values.note: KSh 4.4bn pending bills in 2024, 98% of them older than three years

values.label: Jobs, the port and the economy
values.note: Mombasa produces about 5.1% of national output; the GulfCap–DP World SEZ projects 7,972 direct jobs

values.label: How county money is split between wards
values.note: The County Equitable Share Bill would have shared 30% of KSh 4bn equally across 30 wards; the governor rejected it

values.label: Health
values.note: KSh 4.75bn health allocation in the FY2025/26 estimates; county health indicators to be read from KDHS 2022

values.label: Record and delivery
values.note: No itemised county project register is in hand
